messages.マッチに勝って火力を上げ、破裂を付与する斬撃のアタッカー。: A Slash attacker that wins clashes to increase damage and applies Rupture.
messages.破裂: S1「縦斬り」で破裂2、S3「掻き斬る」の表面的中で破裂1ずつを付与。: **Rupture**: S1 Downward Swing inflicts 2 Rupture, and S3 Ravaging Cut inflicts 1 Rupture on each Heads Hit.
messages.マッチ勝利で強化: S2「連続斬り」はマッチ勝利時にダメージ量+10%/+30%: **Bonuses on Clash Win**: S2 Halberd Combo deals +10%/+30% damage on Clash Win, and S3 grants 1 Attack Power Up on Clash Win.
messages.バトルパッシブ「覚悟」(傲慢×3・保有): このターンに味方が死亡すると、次のタ: **Combat passive — Pluckiness (3 Pride Owned)**: If an ally dies this turn, he gains 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.S1で破裂を入れ、S2・S3はマッチに勝てる相手に当ててダメージを伸ばす。: Inflict Rupture with S1, and throw S2 and S3 at opponents they can beat in Clashes to raise damage.
